children: RNS Number : 0511U  Hill & Smith PLC  09 September 2026
Notification in accordance with listing rule 6.4.9R

Hill & Smith PLC (the 'Company'), the leading provider of solutions that enhance the resilience of vital infrastructure and the built environment, announces that Pete Raby, a Non-executive Director of the Company, will be joining the Board of Renew Holdings plc as Non-executive Director and Chair designate with effect from 5 October 2026. On appointment, Pete will also become a member of the Audit & Risk, Nomination and Remuneration committees.
